# Maestro 1.0.4
- fix for cmd+a on chat screen - [MAE-104: Notch's 'open maestro' does not bring main app into view and focus sometimes](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-104/notchs-open-maestro-does-not-bring-main-app-into-view-and-focus) - [MAE-105: thumbnail drag & drop causes image preview to not working](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-105/thumbnail-drag-and-drop-causes-image-preview-to-not-working) - tentative fix + logs for [MAE-103: replaying markdown animation when opening task](https://linear.app/maestro-will-dominate/issue/MAE-103/replaying-markdown-animation-when-opening-task) - decrease Maestro main app min-width to 400px (previously it was 812px)
